verdict.rationale: Aleph is an AI-native FP&A platform with built-in agents, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never says whether customer data is excluded from AI model training or offers a way to opt out. Encryption, access permissions, and deleting data on trial cancellation are adjacent controls and earn no credit. The "train your agents" wording refers to configuring agents with prompts, not to model-training data policy.
